description: Black to kill the L-shaped white group. White has two outside liberties; remove one and follow up.

A7.comment: Atari from the left. White is forced to extend.

A6.comment: Does not take a liberty. White lives by playing C6.

B7.comment: Atari from below. White is forced to extend.

B6.comment: Does not take a liberty. White lives by extending again at A6.

D7.comment: Doesn't reduce a liberty. White extends at A7 and gets two liberties - the kill becomes much harder.
